title: Zavora's mid-addictions
description: The resourcepack, that adds more than needed
body:
# Mid-addictions for PLS2 Modpack
## Entities
Bee's all iteractions is now Vaultek's skin (my)!
[bees](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b69919e54e8a00fa44be4fd297a0837df74596e1.jpeg)
## Utilities
Ping icon is now coloured!
[In tab and server choosing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dba2613706bea0f60739baa0c01d00e4660ae32e.jpeg)
## Armor
The pumpkin is now can be animal ears!
[Bunny or cat ears](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb6556f89f242157792425874be46131546b9060.jpeg)
### In anvil rename the item:
```
------------------------
ITEM - "NAME" NO QUOTES IN GAME
------------------------
carved pumpkin - "Orange Cat Ears"
carved pumpkin - "Black Cat Ears"
carved pumpkin - "White Cat Ears"
carved pumpkin - "Cream Cat Ears"
```
**And mid-needed another tweaks. More will be added soon!**
